summary: Frontend-only E2E testing (430px mobile viewport, preview URL) of the 3 new Impara features + paywall removal. Verified: (1) 'Riproduci Passo-Passo' opens from BOTH impara-riproduci-btn and impara-quick-passo pill; picker lists 140 unlocked recipes with search; step guide shows step count, progress bar (13%->25%), avatar tip, step text, badges (temp/time on last step), prev disabled on step 1, next/prev update state correctly, bake-finish on last step. (2) Finish flow logged in as fornaio@mikilab.de: POST /api/recipe/complete fired, success toast 'Well done! Your achievement is on the community feed', bake-finished screen with all 3 buttons working (community/again/exit); Social feed shows the NEW post with 'Achievement' badge and localized text '🎉 I just completed the «Whole Soul» recipe step-by-step on MikiLab!'; 6h anti-spam re-post guard works (2nd finish -> generic toast, no duplicate). Guest (logged out) clicking bake-finish correctly opens the auth modal. (3) Shopping list toggle shows/hides shopping-where-to-buy; target input (default 2100 g), presets 500/1000/2000 and manual input all recompute quantities (1.00 kg -> 952 g -> 357 g); categories farine/liquidi/lievito/sale/attrezzi each with 'Where:' tip; copy + WhatsApp buttons present with valid wa.me href. (4) Paywall removal: Impara, Your Lab, Diagnosi (Photo diagnosis via capo-quicklink-diagnosi), Recipes list and recipe detail (Panettone 'Veneziana': full INGREDIENTS + PROCEDURE, no lock icon), and shop tab (shop-page + shop-free-block 'It's all free', no academy-page/consult form) all render with ZERO paywall elements, no € prices and no Sblocca/Subscribe/Go PRO CTAs. Backend not retested (per request) apart from confirming /api/subscription/status returns pro/unlock_all true, diagnosi_limit null, and the traguardo post exists in /api/community/posts.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale monetization copy still shown to users: 'Buy the recipe book or subscribe PRO: recipes appear right away in the AI Plan' — contradicts the now-free app and sits directly above the 'It's all free' block.

issues: No contrast or spacing problems found; dark theme + orange accent consistent. Floating Radio button overlaps bottom content slightly (pre-existing).

action_items: Update/remove the PRO-upsell avatar bubble text in /app/frontend/src/components/AvatarBubbles.jsx:38 (visible on the Shop page) — app is free now.

Dead paywall code cleanup: RecipeList.jsx unlock dialog still contains €4,99 / €29,99 / €149 / 'abbonati PRO' UI (unreachable because recipes are never locked), AcademyHome.jsx diagnosi-limit-upsell 'Passa a PRO · €29,99/mese' (unreachable since diagnosi_limit=null), and Academy.jsx (paid courses + 'Book & pay' consultation) is imported in App.js but never rendered (unused import).
Optional: recipe picker search only matches the current UI language name (searching 'Anima' with EN UI returns 0 while the recipe shows as 'Whole Soul') — consider searching all locale name fields.

Data (low): shopping list flour label comes raw from recipe.flour_type ('Whole Wheat Flour 900 + 630 100 (Spelt)') and reads badly; Panettone 'Veneziana' ingredient list only has Preferment + Salt (no flour/water) — seed data gaps, not code.
critical_code_review_comments: PaywallGate is now a transparent pass-through — good, but the surrounding dead checkout UI (RecipeList buy-single/buy-panettoni/buy-all/buy-subscribe-pro, Academy.jsx consult checkout) is still shipped in the bundle and could be reached by a regression; remove it.

BakeStepByStep.parseSteps splits the procedure on newlines only; recipes whose procedure is a single line with inline '1. 2. 3.' numbering collapse into one step (observed: Veneziana procedure is 1 paragraph). Consider also splitting on ' N. ' patterns.
recipesApi.complete does not pass the UI language; backend composes the Italian base text and relies on stored translations — worked fine in EN, but keep in mind for new languages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (1 stale-copy content bug)
